entry.text:
D1 (CHATROOM_MAX_ROOMS_PER_RUN default 12):
- src/hub.ts:62 `static MAX_ROOMS_PER_RUN = Number(process.env.CHATROOM_MAX_ROOMS_PER_RUN ?? 12);` env-overridable
- src/hub.ts:98-101 counts only rooms with state "open" sharing the swarm-<id> prefix; concluding/closing a room frees a slot; error text tells you so
- src/hub.ts:63 sibling MAX_LIVE_PER_ROOM also defaults to 12
- skills/swarm/SKILL.md:86 the operator's "Normal values" raise it via env (CHATROOM_MAX_ROOMS_PER_RUN=40, MAX_LIVE_PER_ROOM=80) and say "Ask before changing anything on the hub that outlives the room being launched"
- src/index.ts:249 exposes it at GET / so operators can see it
- No script/test/decision under scripts/, src/, docs/decisions/ asserts a different default
D2 ("Do not glob: several scripts launch live seats", scripts/offline-runner.mjs:1):
- scripts/sandbox-claude-live.ts:62 spawn("claude", ...) live seat
- scripts/bench-rq1.ts:164 spawn("claude", ...) seat; bench-rq1.ts:391-394 probes/binds 127.0.0.1 ports
- scripts/bench-build-runtime.ts:145 spawn("claude", ...) detached seat
- scripts/adjudication-replay.ts:89 spawn("claude", ["-p", ...]) live model judge
- scripts/pool-run.ts:282 binds a port (createServer().listen(0,'127.0.0.1'))
- none of these are in the explicit offlineScripts list (scripts/offline-runner.mjs:26-182), so a glob over scripts/* would pull them in
